name: Melanie
source:
Representative of the emotion side of magic, she and Shisui were created by Ven and the Will of the 13th World in order to solve a certain problem. Bright and ready to take on the world head-first, she's a friendly girl who just wants to get along with other people.

On the naive side, she trusts Ven without questioning his intentions much. She often plays the fool just to make others laugh or lighten the mood, but she makes a conscious effort to be aware of how the people around her feel.

[spoiler]Although she doesn't remember her past life as Anholly, she shares the tendency to put on a cheerful smile even when suffering inside.[/spoiler]

[From [url=https://toyhou.se/12606712.melanie]official bio[/url]]
